name: grimmsnarl_ml_v5
deck_note: Unchanged from v1-v5: the exact 60-card Grimmsnarl list used by the selected corpus.
selection_policy: Newest 300 valid same-deck replays per team across submission versions; success and validated skipped_existing rows are eligible.
teacher_selection_note: The refreshed pooled model improves both the new rank-3 team and the existing pin. Pin 16494330 is retained to isolate the data refresh: pin 16422241 tied it 20-20 in direct local play and produced the same 23-17 result versus the old v5 on seed 1705, so changing the pin has no measured outcome benefit yet.

model.kind: LightGBM lambdarank distilled to standard-library tree JSON
model.iteration_selection: 2000 trees is the measured Pareto point: 1238 trees did not show a clear gain; 2500 added only 0.0005 Top-1 over 2000 on the refreshed test; 3515 cost 79.2 MB and about 88 ms/move in the initial timing probe.

policy: The v5 search-budget and one-ply planner rules are unchanged. MAIN and other routed single-pick contexts use the refreshed 2000-tree team-conditioned ranker; low-support context 8 remains on the rule policy.
validation_scope: Data selection is frozen by a SHA256-recorded manifest. The candidate was compared pairwise against ranker_v4 on both refreshed and frozen chronological test blocks, checked separately on the new rank-3 team and the deployed pin, tested with 144 inherited agent tests for each pin candidate, and run for 100 alternating-seat local games against the previous v5. Ladder rating is not yet measured.
description: v5.1 keeps v5's resource-budget fixes and refreshes its formerly byte-identical v4 ranker with newly collected same-deck logs. The promoted 2000-tree model improves agreement on the refreshed field and strongly improves the newly added rank-3 team while preserving the existing teacher pin and frozen-corpus performance.
